programme.title: A Fronteira
programme.desc: Uma repórter americana busca seu irmão desaparecido em meio à violência e ao tráfico de pessoas na fronteira entre os Estados Unidos e o México.

programme.title: Faust, La Venganza Está En La Sangre
programme.desc: Un hombre vende su alma al diablo para obtener superpoderes y vengar la brutal muerte de su novia. Al darse cuenta de que el precio es el alma de su nuevo interés amoroso, se vuelve contra el diablo.

programme.title: Pequeños Accidentes
programme.desc: En una pequeña comunidad conmocionada por un reciente accidente mortal en su mina, la desaparición de un adolescente pone en relación a un minero superviviente de la tragedia, la mujer de un directivo de la mina, y a un chaval taciturno y lleno de secretos.

programme.title: Hitman - O Rei dos Assassinos
programme.desc: Um antigo chefe da máfia japonesa suspeita de ser vítima de um ataque e deixa uma recompensa para a pessoa que encontrar o seu assassino. Então, um assassino contratado e um golpista decidem juntos buscar o enigmático "Rei dos Assassinos " e ganhar o prêmio cobiçado.

programme.title: El misterio de God´s Pocket
programme.desc: El alocado hijastro de Mickey, Leon, muere en un "accidente" de construcción y Mickey, rápidamente, trata de olvidar esta fatalidad intentando enterrar el cuerpo. Pero cuando un columnista local llega para husmear y descubrir la verdad, las cosas empiezan a ir de mal en peor. Mickey se encuentra atrapado en una lucha con un cuerpo inerte al que no puede enterrar, una esposa que es incapaz de complacer y una deuda que nunca podrá pagar.

programme.title: El Lobo Solitario
programme.desc: Inspirado en el libro clásico "El agente secreto" de Joseph Conrad. En una Australia futurista, todos los aspectos de la vida cotidiana pueden ser espiados por el gobierno a través de cámaras, intercepciones telefónicas y sistemas de seguridad. En una oscura librería, un grupo de activistas medioambientales se reúne en secreto. La idealista Winnie y su novio Conrad pretenden atacar el G20, un grupo que reúne a los mayores líderes económicos del mundo, pero no saben que están siendo conducidos a una trampa.

programme.title: Frente à Frente
programme.desc: Cheung Sung-bong é um oficial da Unidade Regional de Crime que trabalhou na frente durante muitos anos. O seu protegido, Yau Kong-ngo, respeita-o e consegue chegar até ele. No entanto, o destino coloca-os uns contra os outros.

programme.title: Cuatro Vidas

programme.title: Insegurança

programme.title: Rescate Sangriento

programme.title: Oscuro deseo
programme.desc: Shane entra en una prestigiosa universidad con una beca de deporte y enseguida hace migas con Brandon, su rico compañero de habitación. Brandon le presenta a su familia y Shane se hace ilusiones de que pertenece a ella. Cuando Brandon lo deja de lado porque ha conocido una chica, las cosas se complican y Brandon acaba muerto. Shane se presenta en la casa de Brandon y lo que empieza como una atracción irresistible con la madre de Brandon se acaba convirtiendo en una obsesión hasta el punto que planea matar al marido para quedarse con todo."

programme.title: Enquanto ela esta Fora
programme.desc: Uma mulher que está fazendo compras na véspera de Natal até tarde da noite é logo aterrorizada por um pequeno grupo de arruaceiros e precisa lutar por sua vida.

programme.title: Faust, La Venganza Está En La Sangre
programme.desc: Un hombre vende su alma al diablo para obtener superpoderes y vengar la brutal muerte de su novia. Al darse cuenta de que el precio es el alma de su nuevo interés amoroso, se vuelve contra el diablo.

programme.title: Cautiva
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds protagoniza a Matthew, padre de Cass, una niña secuestrada, quien ahora tiene 17 años, y que aún está viva. En una terrorífica carrera contra el tiempo, Matthew, los detectives e inclusive la misma Cass deberán representar sus papeles para resolver el misterio de su desaparición y liberarla de su cautiverio.

programme.title: No Rastro da Violência
programme.desc: Fascinada pelas raízes do comportamento violento, a psicóloga renomada Dra. Amanda Tyler tem a oportunidade de entrevistar e analisar Jackson Shea, prisioneiro do corredor da morte.

programme.title: La Cara del diablo
programme.desc: Un grupo de jóvenes viaja a la selva de Tarapoto esperando encontrar mucha diversión

programme.title: Lukas
programme.desc: Un portero de discoteca se ve obligado a colaborar con la policía. Esta es su última oportunidad para no perder la custodia de su hija de ocho años. Su misión: infiltrarse en la organización de un peligroso líder de una pandilla holandesa que falsifica dinero.

programme.title: Hitman - O Rei dos Assassinos
programme.desc: Um antigo chefe da máfia japonesa suspeita de ser vítima de um ataque e deixa uma recompensa para a pessoa que encontrar o seu assassino. Então, um assassino contratado e um golpista decidem juntos buscar o enigmático "Rei dos Assassinos " e ganhar o prêmio cobiçado.

programme.title: McCanick
programme.desc: A lo largo de un día, un detective de narcóticos persigue a un joven delincuente aparentemente inofensivo que conoce una verdad sobre el pasado del policía.

programme.title: El Ejecutor
programme.desc: Kung Wei es un agente encubierto de la policía china por lo que no puede hablar a su esposa de su trabajo ni asistir a las competiciones de kung fu en las que participa su hijo Johnny. En su nueva misión, Kung se infiltra en una tríada de Hong Kong bajo el mando de Po Kwong, un psicópata criminal. Sin embargo todo se complica cuando se descubre que es policía y raptan a su hijo por lo que Kung Wei y Johnny tendrán que unir su habilidad y destreza en las artes marciales para poder sobrevivir.

programme.title: Frente à Frente
programme.desc: Cheung Sung-bong é um oficial da Unidade Regional de Crime que trabalhou na frente durante muitos anos. O seu protegido, Yau Kong-ngo, respeita-o e consegue chegar até ele. No entanto, o destino coloca-os uns contra os outros.

programme.title: Cuatro Vidas
programme.desc: Cuatro vidas se basa en un proverbio chino según el cual la existencia humana se divide en cuatro emociones: felicidad, placer, pena y amor. Estas emociones acaban cruzándose a través de cuatro personajes.

programme.title: End Game – Robo de Identidad
programme.desc: Cuando un asesino pierde la memoria, un actor sin éxito intercambia identidades con él.

programme.title: Oscuro deseo
programme.desc: Shane entra en una prestigiosa universidad con una beca de deporte y enseguida hace migas con Brandon, su rico compañero de habitación. Brandon le presenta a su familia y Shane se hace ilusiones de que pertenece a ella. Cuando Brandon lo deja de lado porque ha conocido una chica, las cosas se complican y Brandon acaba muerto. Shane se presenta en la casa de Brandon y lo que empieza como una atracción irresistible con la madre de Brandon se acaba convirtiendo en una obsesión hasta el punto que planea matar al marido para quedarse con todo."

programme.title: Massacre no Bairro Chinês
programme.desc: Jackie Chan faz o papel de um fugitivo do Japão que se torna um assassino para a máfia. O longa é focado na vida de imigrantes chineses que vivem no Japão.

programme.title: Levantar
programme.desc: La historia real de un joven acusado falsamente de violación y condenado a seis años de prisión de máxima seguridad. Debe confiar en sus habilidades de supervivencia y en un vínculo improbable con un recluso infame para demostrar su inocencia y recuperar su libertad.

programme.title: El misterio de God´s Pocket
programme.desc: El alocado hijastro de Mickey, Leon, muere en un "accidente" de construcción y Mickey, rápidamente, trata de olvidar esta fatalidad intentando enterrar el cuerpo. Pero cuando un columnista local llega para husmear y descubrir la verdad, las cosas empiezan a ir de mal en peor. Mickey se encuentra atrapado en una lucha con un cuerpo inerte al que no puede enterrar, una esposa que es incapaz de complacer y una deuda que nunca podrá pagar.

programme.title: Insegurança
programme.desc: Os donos de uma empresa de segurança falida começam a assaltar casas para impulsionar os negócios.

programme.title: El Niño De Barro
programme.desc: Buenos Aires, 1912. Una serie de asesinatos a menores se propaga por la ciudad. Mateo, un nino de 10 anos, esconde un secreto: a veces su mente le conduce a un lugar de la memoria en donde es testigo de los asesinatos. Al descubrirse su secreto muchos creerán que es el asesino. Estela, su madre, con el apoyo del forense de la policía trata de encontrar una explicación a las visiones.

programme.title: Rescate Sangriento
programme.desc: Un ex mafioso ruso que ahora es escritor de novelas policiales debe enfrentarse a su pasado cuando su familia es blanco de la violencia.

programme.title: Enquanto ela esta Fora
programme.desc: Uma mulher que está fazendo compras na véspera de Natal até tarde da noite é logo aterrorizada por um pequeno grupo de arruaceiros e precisa lutar por sua vida.

programme.title: Far Haven
programme.desc: Es 1887, Braddock regresa a Far Haven, a sus hijos, pero su suegro es atacado y debera enfrentar la corrupcion que estrangula al pueblo.

programme.title: Mistrust
programme.desc: Al no tener compromisos y nunca ser vulnerable, Veronica disfruta de ser una amante. Se da cuenta de que su mejor amiga tiene la llave de su corazón y es la única capaz de extraer sus emociones.

programme.title: Top 10: Secretos y misterios
programme.desc: Descubre en este episodio las mega estructuras antiguas.

programme.title: Far Haven

programme.title: Un Milagro en Texas
programme.desc: Un Milagro en Texas es una comedia desternillante que se desarrolla en el corazón de la Gran Depresión. John Ratzenberger y Kevin Sorbo brillan interpretando a dos astutos estafadores que urden un plan para conquistar a viudas y convencerlas de invertir en sus aparentemente inútiles empresas de pozos de petróleo. Las risas no se hacen esperar mientras las viudas luchan con sus decisiones, solo para que la situación se invierta cuando un giro inesperado del destino conduce a un auténtico hallazgo de petróleo.

programme.title: Cerco de Terror 26/11 – La Serie
programme.sub-title: La Calma Antes de la Tormenta
programme.desc: El Coronel Sahota lucha por conseguir mejoras para la NSG. Mientras tanto, la vida en Mumbai continúa con normalidad, sin saber de la amenaza inminente. Parvati, una joven periodista, enfrenta obstáculos para que su reportaje sea aprobado por el canal de noticias.

programme.title: Apartamento 12
programme.desc: Un artista encuentra su vida patas arriba de repente cuando su exposición se cancela y su novia lo deja.

programme.title: Un Milagro en Texas
programme.desc: Un Milagro en Texas es una comedia desternillante que se desarrolla en el corazón de la Gran Depresión. John Ratzenberger y Kevin Sorbo brillan interpretando a dos astutos estafadores que urden un plan para conquistar a viudas y convencerlas de invertir en sus aparentemente inútiles empresas de pozos de petróleo. programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Obreros roban en la casa de los Guerrero, pero Alejandro mata a uno y renuncia a la alcaldía. Esa noche descubre la verdad sobre la muerte de Ortega y el matrimonio forzado de Eduardo. Días después, cuando solo empresas privadas pueden licitar, comienzan alianzas en el pueblo, marcando un nuevo rumbo en la disputa por las minas.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Alcides golpea a Olga y el Padre Javier lo enfrenta. Olga pide el divorcio y lo expulsa. Ese día, una explosión ilegal en la mina sepulta a obreros, y Eduardo ordena dejarlos enterrados. Además, excluye a “El Tigre” del negocio, generando su rencor.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Ricardo se postula a la alcaldía mientras Rubén chantajea al Gobernador para quedarse con el cargo. El Padre Javier y Olga se enamoran pese a la oposición de la iglesia, Alcides intenta matarlo y lo hiere. Años después, Alcira regresa para vengarse de Eduardo, quien sigue apoderándose de las minas, generando tensión entre los esmeralderos.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo retoma el contrabando de las esmeraldas engañando a Esperanza para drogarla y violarla. Al otro día, Ricardo decide regresar con ella. Horas más tarde, Alcides pone una bomba en el carro de los militares en que Olga se sube por casualidad, aunque su exesposo intenta impedirlo, la bomba estalla dejándola en estado crítico.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: El atentado deja muy afectado a Eduardo, haciendo que despida a Alcides, también descubre que él los robaba. Días después, Rubén gana la alcaldía del pueblo de forma deshonesta. Por otra parte, el Padre Javier regresa para ver a Olga.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Reina y Esmeralda por fin encuentra piedras en la mina, que suponía estaba ya seca. Por otra parte, Adelaida le tiende una trampa a Eduardo, junto a Alcira para vengarse. Más tarde, Reina encuentra a Verónica y a Octavio en la cama, enfurecida les prohíbe continuar con ese tipo de relación. Al mismo tiempo, el Padre Javier retorna para denunciar a Alcides.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Octavio encuentra a su padre. Días después, Eduardo llega para atormentar a Esperanza, contándole toda la verdad a Ricardo, por la cual la abandona. Finalmente, se revelan las extorsiones que llevaron a Rubén a la alcaldía, en consecuencia este es destituido.

programme.title: Parejas Criminales
programme.desc: El dentista forense Dr. Carl Leung narra su colaboración con la Policía de Hong Kong en el 'Asesinato de Hello Kitty' y su papel en resolver una ola de asesinatos.

programme.title: Tango Shalom
programme.desc: Cuando una bailarina de tango le pide a un rabino que participe en un concurso de baile, surge un gran problema: ¡debido a sus creencias ortodoxas, no puede tocarla! Pero el dinero del premio salvaría a su escuela de la bancarrota, por lo que desarrollan un plan para participar en la competencia sin sacrificar su fe, y los lazos de la familia y la comunidad se ponen a prueba con un deslumbrante paso de baile a la vez en esta alegre fábula.

programme.title: Por el Amor de George
programme.desc: Una esposa abandonada deja a su marido y viaja a Los Ángeles en busca del hombre de sus sueños: George Clooney, ¡y se detendrá ante todo para conocerlo!

programme.title: #Número de la Suerte
programme.desc: La vida de un joven está en una racha de derrotas, hasta que obtiene el antiguo número de celular de una importante estrella del baloncesto apodado "El Santo" y comienza a usarlo para obtener acceso VIP a fiestas de primer nivel. Está viviendo la buena vida... Hasta que su ídolo se entera.

programme.title: A Árvore Da Vida
programme.desc: O jovem Jack é um dos três irmãos que cresceram como parte da família O'Brien em uma pequena cidade do Texas. Jack tem um relacionamento controverso com seu pai, mas se dá bem com sua bela mãe. Como adulto, Jack luta com seu passado e tenta dar sentido à sua infância, ao mesmo tempo em que se debate com questões existenciais maiores.

programme.title: Carol
programme.desc: Nueva York, años 50. Therese Belivet, una joven dependienta de una tienda de Manhattan que sueña con una vida mejor, conoce un día a Carol Aird, una mujer elegante y sofisticada que se encuentra atrapada en un matrimonio infeliz. Entre ellas surge una atracción inmediata, cada vez más intensa y profunda, que cambiará sus vidas para siempre

programme.title: Amor Sin Tiempo
programme.desc: Megan parece tener la vida perfecta: una relación amorosa con un maravilloso esposo llamado Thomas y dos adorables hijos. Luego se encuentra despertando de un coma y descubre que no está y que nunca se ha casado. Thomas y los niños parecen no existir. Sus padres se preocupan por ella y Megan lucha por dejar de lado la realidad con la que soñaba.

programme.title: Enquanto Estivermos Juntos
programme.desc: Um professor universitário alcoólatra em recuperação conhece uma nova aluna sedutora. Ela oferece a ele uma fuga sensual da realidade até que ele perceba que ela pode ser louca.

programme.title: No Quiero Ser Recuerdo
programme.desc: A pesar de que lo esperaban, la madrugada en que su madre falleció, el mundo de Vega se cubrió con un manto de tristeza bajo el que solamente podría distinguir la mirada desordenada y afligida de su padre. Y en los más oscuro de su desconcierto conoció a Nico, un pintor callejero que llenó su universo de color a pinceladas de ternura, amor y libertad

programme.title: El árbol de la vida
programme.desc: El joven Jack es uno de los tres hermanos que crecen como parte de la familia O'Brien en un pequeño pueblo de Texas. Jack tiene una relación conflictiva con su padre, pero se lleva bien con su bella madre. De adulto, Jack lucha con su pasado y trata de dar sentido a su infancia, al tiempo que se enfrenta a cuestiones existenciales más importantes.

programme.title: Enquanto Houver Esperança
programme.desc: Esta é a história de Angélica, uma garota de 16 anos que está lutando contra um tipo raro de câncer chamado Síndrome Mielodisplásica, sua luta para tentar viver uma vida normal e sua esperança de encontrar seu primeiro amor antes que seja tarde demais.

programme.title: El Principe Enamorado
programme.desc: Carlos, príncipe de una corona centroeuropea, llega a la Costa Brava con la intención de pasar unas semanas de descanso. María, que trabaja en la clínica veterinaria de su padre, conoce a Carlos por casualidad. Los dos ocultan su verdadera identidad y establecen una relación muy especial. Pronto se descubren sus mentiras mutuas. Carlos descubre que María tiene una hija y María se entera de la condición principesca de Carlos por unas fotos publicadas en la prensa sensacionalista.

programme.title: A Bela e a Fera
programme.desc: Uma visão mais dark do conto de amor proibido entre a delicada Bela e a mais temida besta da floresta, a Fera. Quando os aldeões estão sendo brutalmente assassinados, a Fera é caçada como sendo responsável pelas mortes. A Bela e a Fera se juntam para descobrir e combater o responsável pelos crimes. e 16 Estimado 16 Anos

programme.title: Princesa en el paraíso
programme.desc: El rey Edvard y la reina Paige vuelan al ficticio Sangyoon para la boda concertada de la princesa Myra, quien ama a un chico humilde. Eddie y Paige ayudan, pero encuentran problemas y un elefante real; Sin embargo, aún así, el amor verdadero prevalece.

programme.title: Grandes Momentos
programme.desc: Enquanto sua irmã Beth se prepara para o casamento, Sarah se vê em uma situação complicada após terminar o relacionamento. Uma redefinição do panorama emocional dos relacionamentos modernos, onde uma jovem é forçada a reaprender a amar e a ser amada.

programme.title: Me Enamoré de Una Chica Cristiana
programme.desc: Miles es un narcotraficante de alto nivel retirado. El único inconveniente de Miles es su círculo de amigos.

programme.title: Palm Springs
programme.desc: Dos desconocidos quedan atrapados en un bucle temporal durante una boda en Palm Springs, viviendo el mismo día una y otra vez.

programme.title: Um Encontro com o Destino
programme.desc: Depois de saber que ela foi incumbida de cuidar dos filhos de seu primo falecido, uma arquiteta fica dividida entre se concentrar em sua carreira e honrar o desejo de seu primo.

programme.title: Sigue a tu corazón
programme.desc: Kathy Yoder ha dejado sus costumbres Amish y es una exitosa escritora de guías de viaje. Cuando Kathy vuelve a casa para arreglar los asuntos de su padre, recuerda su vida antes de dejar la comunidad Amish.

programme.title: La gran enfermedad del amor
programme.desc: Comedia romántica nominada al Oscar a Mejor Guion Original. Kumail y Emily son una pareja que se conoce en un espectáculo de comedia. A pesar de sus diferencias culturales, su relación empieza a avanzar, complicando las vidas de todos por las expectativas de los estrictos padres de Kumail.

Una redefinición del paisaje emocional en las relaciones de hoy en día, donde una joven se ve obligada a volver a aprender a amar y ser amada.

programme.title: Conversaciones con otras Mujeres
programme.desc: En una boda en un hotel de Nueva York, un hombre y una mujer de unos cuarenta años se conocen y entablan una ingeniosa conversación llena de dobles sentidos. Ella fuma continuamente y él bebe sin cesar, mientras ambos despliegan sus estrategias para acercarse. Ella, con su acento británico y su habilidad para mantener a los hombres a distancia, atrae su atención con sus ocurrencias. Él, por su parte, utiliza múltiples tácticas para asediarla, resultando finalmente irresistible.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Alors que Red plaide devant les tribunaux pour maintenir son accord d'immunité, Liz et la Task Force interrogent un homme dont l'héritage récent semble trop beau pour être vrai.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: L'apparition mystérieuse d'une jeune fille inconnue lance Liz et la Task Force sur la piste de sa connexion avec le secret que cache Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red se rend au Costa Rica pour éviter que le sac d'os ne soit vendu au plus offrant lors d'une mystérieuse vente aux enchères.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz et Red s'opposent dans une course épique pour retrouver l'homme en possession du sac d'os, forçant la vérité à éclater.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red présente à la Task Force un nouveau nom de la blacklist : Dr. Koehler, un chirurgien plastique qui crée de nouvelles identités pour des criminels recherchés. Liz et sa soeur Jennifer, enquêtent secrètement sur les événements qui se sont déroulés la nuit où le vrai Raymond Reddington est décédé.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red est envoyé dans un établissement médical fédéral à la suite de sa demande d'évaluation psychiatrique auprès du tribunal. Liz et Jennifer recherche une personne de la Blacklist qui, à leur avis, pourrait détenir de précieuses informations sur le passé de Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Alors que Red et Dembe sollicitent l'aide de Glen pour que le jury soit clément lors du procès de Red, la task force enquête sur une série de morts mystérieuses.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Alors que Liz et Jennifer recherchent une femme qui pourrait connaître un secret du passé de Red, elles se retrouvent menacées par un dangereux trafiquant. Pendant ce temps, Red joue le rôle de médiateur entre deux gangs rivaux en prison.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Tandis que Red se bat devant le tribunal pour blanchir son nom une fois pour toutes, Liz et la Task-Force enquêtent sur une personne de la Blacklist qui a la réputation de s'enrichir sur les secrets des autres.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La Task Force explore le monde non réglementé de la crypto-monnaie afin de déjouer une attaque imminente.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz et la Task Force essayent de découvrir la vérité sur un assassinat dans un ultime effort pour sauver la vie de Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cooper met en jeu sa réputation en faisant appel à la Maison-Blanche pour défendre Red. De leur côté, Liz et la Task Force reprennent leurs recherches sur Le Corse, un homme de la blacklist lié à un complot international.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red et la Task Force se lancent à la recherche du légendaire fugitif Robert Vesco, l'un des escrocs les plus célèbres de l'histoire.

programme.title: Duval & Moretti
programme.desc: Duval et Moretti recueillent Lola, la fille d'un comptable laissé pour mort après un règlement de comptes. Tout en menant l'enquête pour découvrir qui a tenté de tuer le père de Lola, Duval et Moretti jouent les baby-sitters. Mais leur jeune protégée réussit à filer en douce, en emportant l'arme de Duval. Duval et Moretti réalisent alors que la jeune fille a décidé de venger son père. Elle est en grand danger.

programme.title: Duval & Moretti
programme.desc: Duval est pris pour cible par Ibanez, un dangereux chef de gang qui lui fait porter le chapeau pour un meurtre qu'il n'a pas commis. Personne ne croit Duval, qui se voit obligé de fuir la police des polices. Moretti commence à s'inquiéter quand Duval disparaît sans laisser de trace. Et pour cause : Duval a été kidnappé par Ibanez, qui le menotte au volant de sa voiture avant de la pousser du haut d'une falaise... Ibanez décide alors de s'occuper du cas de Moretti.

programme.title: Duval & Moretti
programme.desc: Duval et Moretti travaillent sur une affaire de faux billets et soupçonnent Tarek, un dangereux trafiquant. Nico Moretti débarque alors à Paris et s'installe chez son frère. David est ravi de l'héberger, mais un peu moins quand Nico lui avoue avoir des dettes... Aurait-il replongé ? David Moretti s'inquiète, et pour ne rien arranger, Tarek reste introuvable.

programme.title: Duval & Moretti
programme.desc: Duval et Moretti enquêtent sur la mort du célèbre chirurgien esthétique Laurent Duplessis. Tout semble indiquer que Siloff, un criminel qu'ils pensaient mort dans un accident de la route, est toujours en vie et serait même impliqué dans le meurtre de Laurent Duplessi... Duval et Moretti interrogent Mathilde Duplessis, la veuve du chirurgien, mais en vain... Cacherait-elle des informations capitales ?

programme.title: Duval & Moretti
programme.desc: De dangereux criminels détournent un fourgon blindé de transport de fonds. Ils prennent plusieurs otages qu'ils prévoient d'exécuter une fois leur fuite réussie. Duval et Moretti sont chargés d'arrêter les braqueurs et de sauver les otages... À l'insu des ravisseurs, ils déploient toutes les ruses possibles pour tenter d'entrer en contact avec les otages coincés à l'intérieur du véhicule.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.sub-title: Tap Dancing Her Way Right Back Into Your Heart
programme.desc: Starsky se fait passer pour un prof de danse et Hutch pour Charlie McCabe, riche propriétaire texan et danseur, pour mettre au jour une opération de chantage.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: Starsky et Hutch ont des soupçons en voyant un capitaine de police ayant un dossier professionnel extraordinaire accepter une enveloppe d'un maître-chanteur.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: Deux voyoux violent et agressent une adolescente atteinte de déficience mentale. Mauvaise nouvelle pour eux : Lisa est une amie de Starsky et Hutch, qui feront tout pour les mettre derrière les barreaux.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: À titre de représailles pour avoir arrêté le gourou Simon Marcus, coupable d'un meurtre collectif, Starsky est enlevé et retenu prisonnier dans un local secret de la secte. Hutch parviendra-t-il à déchiffrer les indices énigmatiques de Marcus et à trouver son ami avant qu'il ne soit sacrifié ?

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: Les affaires roulent lorsque Huggy et un ancien shérif créent leur propre agence de détectives privés.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: Suite à une étrange imposture, un citoyen moyen bien-pensant tue un témoin d'État important dans "Traquenard", un épisode spécial en deux parties de "Starsky et Hutch".

programme.title: Carrie La Vengeance
programme.desc: Après avoir été humiliée à un bal, une jeune fille aux pouvoirs surnaturels décide de se venger…

programme.title: Sheena Reine De La Jungle
programme.desc: Orpheline, la blonde Sheena est recueillie par une tribu qui lui apprend à communiquer par télépathie avec les animaux. Un journaliste télé à l'esprit caustique, Vic Casey, lui donne une leçon en amour personnelle. En Afrique pour un reportage sur un joueur de football de sang royal, le Prince Otwani, Vic se trouve rapidement mêlé à un nid d'intrigues politiques.

programme.title: Les Cavaliers De L'Ombre
programme.desc: Deux frères décident de retrouver leurs soeurs qui ont été kidnappé...

programme.title: Rédemption
programme.desc: Sean Porter, un officier contrôleur judiciaire, a décidé de créer une équipe de football avec des jeunes détenus réputés pour être dangereux. Il est convaincu que c'est le seul moyen de leur enseigner leur respect d'eux-mêmes et des autres et de leur apprendre à s'intégrer dans la société.

programme.title: Glory
programme.desc: 1863 - La Guerre de Sécession ravage les États-Unis. Le jeune Robert Gould Shaw est promu colonel du premier régiment de soldats noirs, engagés volontaires dans une guerre qu'ils croient être la leur. Ils se trompent. Assignés à des tâches subalternes, méprisés par leurs officiers, ils se révoltent, avec Shaw à leur tête. Volontaires pour partir à l'assaut de l'imprenable Fort Wagner, ces héros paieront le prix fort pour retrouver leurs dignités.

programme.title: The Patriot
programme.desc: Caroline du Sud, 1776. Le conflit entre les independantistes et les Anglais semble inevitable. Benjamin Martin sait trop bien ce qu'est une guerre et il n'en veut pas. Cet ancien heros des combats contre les Francais et les Indiens n'ignore rien de la violence des affrontements armes... Aujourd'hui veuf, il eleve seul ses sept enfants dans sa plantation.

programme.title: Equalizer
programme.desc: Robert McCall, un homme qui pense avoir rangé son passé mystérieux derrière lui, se consacre à sa nouvelle vie tranquille. Au moment où il rencontre Teri, une jeune fille sous le contrôle de gangsters russes violents, il décide d'agir. McCall sort ainsi de sa retraite et voit son désir de justice réveillé.

programme.title: Don't Breathe
programme.desc: Pour échapper à la violence de sa mère et sauver sa jeune sœur d'une existence sans avenir, Rocky est prête à tout. Avec ses amis Alex et Money, elle a déjà commis quelques cambriolages, mais rien qui leur rapporte assez pour enfin quitter Détroit. Lorsque le trio entend parler d'un aveugle qui vit en solitaire et garde chez lui une petite fortune, ils préparent ce qu'ils pensent être leur ultime coup. Mais leur victime va se révéler bien plus effrayante, et surtout bien plus dangereuse que ce à quoi ils s'attendaient…

programme.title: Good Luck Chuck
programme.desc: La superstar de Hollywood Jessica Alba (Fantastic Four, Into The Blue) et le comique Dane Cook tiennent la vedette dans cette comédie romantique désopilante. Un homme qui a rompu avec celle qui fut longtemps sa petite amie est surpris d'apprendre qu'elle a décidé de se fiancer avec celui qu'elle vient de rencontrer. Il répète le modèle et des célibataires commencent à le fréquenter dans l'espoir de trouver M. Parfait.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Pour impressionner sa petite amie Vanessa et a la suite d'un quiproquo, Sonny, celibataire endurci, fait croire qu'il est le pere naturel de Julian, un jeune garcon de cinq ans qu'il adopte. programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?

For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.sub-title: Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Stella And Sam
programme.desc: As they explore the world in all its seasons, Stella and Sam have wild adventures and comical mishaps. They make friends and discover many things - especially about themselves. If Sam is bold enough to rescue Fred from the sprinkler, then maybe he really can be brave enough to have a sleepover in the backyard tent. Every day is a new adventure, and Stella and Sam share the joy of discovering that they have what it takes to face the biggest adventure of all... growing up.

programme.title: Jenny’s Magic Shop
programme.desc: Jenny and her best friend Blam the Teddy Bear run a magic shop in the town of Dreamville, where everybody can come for magical help. The residents of Dreamville always leave the shop thanking Jenny, but actually, they set the stage for their own miracles, leaving behind in the shop whatever is keeping them from living life and making decisions. After all, the ability to change yourself is the truest form of magic. Jenny and Blam never refuse to help anyone, but it often happens that they’re the ones who need help, since Jenny’s still a kid and Blam’s an eccentric teddy bear.

Tow truck help other cars, when they are broken down. Watch new car cartoon and learn about helper cars!

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.title: Everything's Rosie
programme.desc: Join Rosie and her friends as they go on fun adventures, play games and solve problems. Each episode contains an educational message so that kids are engaged while learning. With a focus on friendship the show also promotes positivity through teamwork.

programme.title: TurboZaurs
programme.desc: The adventures of dinosaur’s squad transforming into big machines who are willing to solve any difficulties that kids may face in their everyday life.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Mya Go

programme.desc: Embark on an electrifying journey as they boldly leap from one heart-pounding expedition to the next, fueled by their unbreakable bond and insatiable thirst for excitement. programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Rush teams up with longtime friend and fellow angler Jesus Diaz for a well-earned "busman's holiday" in the beautiful waters of Key West. Even on a day off, these two can't resist seeing what's going to bite. Taking the wind and the tides into account, the duo maps out a strategic circuit through Key West's surrounding waters to target cobia, grouper, snapper, and tuna for a busy day "off" work.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: As part of this year's Star brite Sea Safe event, we hit the water to experience some of the incredible fishing the Indian River Lagoon has to offer. For Rush, that meant some serious bow time with close friend Alex Hughey - on the hunt for some of the biggest snook we've ever encountered. The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Join Rush and his good friend Anthony Solmo for an epic day of fishing in the stunning waters of Key West, Florida! Leaving the Odyssea at the dock, they hop on a bay boat outfitted with a trolling motor for the ultimate inshore adventure. Gliding quietly through the shallows, they target a variety of species—including hard-pulling Tarpon and explosive topwater Jacks—leaving Rush thinking, “A guy could get used to this kind of fishing!”

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Exploring New Zealand’s Wild Flavors, Māori Culture & Volcanic Hot Spring Cooking"
programme.desc: They say you come to New Zealand as a stranger, but leave as family. In this episode of DIRT, the crew goes full circle—meeting Muttonbird chefs Emma and George on the South Island before hopping up to Raglan and working their way back down. Water skiing next to snow-capped mountains, cooking in hot springs the Māori way, and stargazing at Wairarapa Dark Sky Reserve are all on the itinerary. But it’s the final “Feed” done Kiwi-style that makes one thing clear—in this unique and stunning land, nobody’s a stranger for long.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Road Trip Angler
programme.desc: In this episode of Road Trip Angler, Jameson Redding is exploring St. Marks, Florida, along with his friend Chris Funk trying to catch a species of Bass that is unique to the area.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Big Waves, Wild Foraging and the Fight to Preserve Hawaiian Culture"
programme.desc: The best way to learn is by doing, especially in Hawaiʻi. Teaming up with locals like Chef Mark "Gooch" Noguchi, Nathan Florence, and Jack Johnson, the DIRT crew dove headfirst into the rugged microclimates and deep-rooted cultures that define the islands. Charging waves, tracking invasive Axis deer, and diving for dinner gave Josh and the gang a visceral education in what makes this archipelago so singular. The hard work and good times culminated in a final feast as complex and generous as Hawaiʻi itself.
